coverage_notes: Bounded supplementary recall watch completed with 12 targeted web searches.

Covered only/sole/last/full-service grocery loss, disaster-related food-distribution cancellation or suspension, abrupt pantry/food-bank service reduction, and immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption.
No new qualifying signal was verified within the hourly search window.

Hatteras Island reporting was reviewed because N.C. 12 remained closed and local stores reported some fresh produce and meat becoming limited while Dare County coordinated food-supply trucks; the underlying access disruption was documented earlier on September 26 and was not retained as a new signal for this hourly window.

Fresh Hawaii storm coverage was reviewed; emergency distributions remained scheduled on Kauai and Hawaii Island Food Basket warehouse closures were already-known storm impacts rather than new signals in this window.
Routine promotions, donation/resource items, generic inflation, recycled reports, and unsupported claims were excluded.
